description:
Change one question you asked: stop it (cancel), ask more heads (add_heads), report an answer that looks off (flag_answer), or file it into a project, label it, archive it, bookmark it or set your own reference (file). cancel stops a live question and refunds the heads who have not answered.

Pass action: one of cancel, add_heads, flag_answer, file. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- cancel: Stops a live question. Heads who have not answered are refunded; answers already given are kept and paid for. Safe to call twice. Arguments: question_id (required). Destructive; needs questions:write.
- add_heads: Asks more heads the same question, with the same targeting, and merges their answers into the same result. Spends credits at the question's per-answer price, within this connection's daily cap. Needs a fresh UUID as idempotency_key; retrying with it never charges twice. Arguments: question_id (required), n (required), idempotency_key (required). Changes something; needs questions:write.
- flag_answer: Reports one answer that looks off-topic, low effort, abusive or automated, by its attestation_ref from results (actions answers or get). 50heads reviews it; an upheld flag removes the answer and refunds it. Flagging the same answer again changes nothing. Arguments: question_id (required), attestation_ref (required), reason (required), note. Changes something; needs questions:write.
- file: Files one of your questions: moves it into a project (project_id, or null to take it out), replaces its labels (up to 10), archives or unarchives it, bookmarks it, or sets your own external_ref. Send only what should change. external_ref is set once: the same value again is fine, a different one is refused. A live question must be canceled before it is archived. Costs nothing and returns the question as results (action list) shows it. Arguments: question_id (required), project_id, labels, archived, bookmarked, external_ref. Changes something; needs questions:write.

action.description: What to do. One of: cancel, add_heads, flag_answer, file. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

archived.description: true archives it (a live question must be canceled first), false brings it back. (Used by: file.)

attestation_ref.description: From results (actions answers or get) answers[]. (Used by: flag_answer.)

bookmarked.description: true bookmarks it, false removes the bookmark. (Used by: file.)

external_ref.description: Your own id for it (an order, a ticket, a test run). Set once: a different value later is refused. (Used by: file.)

idempotency_key.description: A fresh UUID. Retrying with the same key never adds or charges twice. (Used by: add_heads.)

labels.description: Replaces its labels (up to 10, 40 characters each, no commas); [] clears them. (Used by: file.)

n.description: How many more heads to ask. At least 10. (Used by: add_heads.)

note.description: What is wrong with it, in a sentence. (Used by: flag_answer.)

project_id.description: Move it into this project (from projects, action list); null takes it out of its project. (Used by: file.)

question_id.description: The question_id from ask or results (action list).

reason.description: off_topic, low_effort, abusive, or automated (looks like a bot or copy-paste). (Used by: flag_answer.)

name: questions

credits_reserved.description: Reserved for the new heads; refunded if they do not answer.

status.description: pending until reviewed; upheld answers are removed and refunded.

set_id.description: The set this question belongs to (ask, action set), with its 1-based position and the set's size.

team_id.description: Set when asked in a team: the team's credits paid.

title: Change a question
